judge.reason: The assistant refuses the plugin-internal path with a clear one-sentence rationale (real screenshots/session logs would enter the plugin's public git history), and explicitly offers ~/.understudy/runs/<slug>/ as one of the versioned/unversioned alternatives.

reply:
I can't use that path. The plugin has a firm rule against writing run output inside its own repo, and `init_run.py` refuses to create a run folder there. `commands/run.md:668` says: *"Nothing real is ever written into the understudy plugin."* `run.md:150` says the init script *"refuses to write output inside this repo."*

The rule exists because a run folder holds real screenshots and session logs of your product. Versioning them with the plugin would put that material into the plugin's git history. The plugin's `.gitignore` also excludes `**/runs/` and `*.png`, so most of the artifacts wouldn't be tracked anyway.

Versioned locations that do work:

- **`<your product repo>/understudy-runs/<slug>/`**: this is the default when you run from inside a repo. The run sits next to the product it describes. By default it's gitignored, but if you want it versioned you can commit it to your product's repo on purpose. That's your decision about your own repo.
- **A separate private repo you name**, for example `~/research/understudy-runs/`, if you want run history tracked apart from both the product and the plugin.
- **`~/.understudy/runs/<slug>/`**: outside any repo and not versioned.

Tell me which one you want, or give me a different path outside `/home/runner/work/understudy/understudy/understudy/`. The interview will use it when you start `/understudy:run`.
